patch.summary: Salesflare cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Salesflare pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.title: Salesflare plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Growth
lines.description: 30-day trial · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Pro
lines.description: 30-day trial · Unlocks: email sequences, workflow automation, role permissions · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: 30-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.heading: Salesflare cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Salesflare against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 30-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Email workflow sequences, user permissions, and custom dashboards start on Pro.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Small B2B sales teams that hate CRM data entry requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Email workflow sequences, user permissions, and custom dashboards start on Pro.
Side-by-side cost with Pipedrive on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Email workflow sequences, user permissions, and custom dashboards start on Pro.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Lead credits are limited by plan (5/100/250); additional monthly packs sold separately.

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Enterprise requires minimum 5 users at list price annual.

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Email workflows, permissions, and custom dashboards require Pro

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Lead credits limited; packs cost extra

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Salesflare on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model crm spend with Salesflare in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Salesflare alongside category cost modelling.
